maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The three identified keypoints in the uppermost row are arranged in a sparse linear formation, oriented parallel to and approximately 5-8 pixel-widths above the primary dense vibrissae row.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium surface exhibits approximately 95-98% melanin saturation, characterized by a uniform distribution of dark pixels with negligible pale or pink-toned pixel clusters.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: A continuous concave contour is visible from the superior orbital ridge to the nasal tip, defining a shallow dish-shaped profile in this strictly lateral view.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor tissue irregularities and small V-shaped notches are visible along the superior and posterior margins of both ear pinnae.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast region of white pelage is present on the mandibular and sub-mandibular regions, sharply delineated from the surrounding tawny fur.
